AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Planning Commission welcomes and encourages public participation at meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to AB 361 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health officer's recommended measures to promote social distancing. All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed; however, the meeting will be recorded and made available on the City's website. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:

BY TELEPHONE: Call (669) 900-9128 and enter Zoom ID 841 2927 5250

HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Please submit your correspondence in writing to PlanningCommissionMeeting@pvestates.org. Comments received by NOON on Tuesday, November 23, 2021 will be included with the posted agenda. Additional comments received by NOON on Tuesday, November 30, 2021 will be forwarded to the Commissioners and posted online as late correspondence. All correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to participate under COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC or on any item of interest on the Agenda by simply utilizing the "Raise Hand" feature during the item under consideration. When called upon to speak please state your name for the record. Members of the public are not required to submit notification in advance.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under Planning Commission Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

  Action: Lazzaro moved and Nendick seconded to approve Resolution No. PCR-2021-1253 (3-0
  in favor; Wade recused).

OLD BUSINESS

6.  NC-1704-21 & G-1653-21; Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading applications for remodel and
  additions to the existing single-family residence located at 4036 Via Solano. Lot 13, Block 6310,
  Tract 7143. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title
  14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner: James Schuchert
  Speakers: Mike Connelly, Ben O'Rourke

  Action: Nendick moved and Wade seconded to approve Resolution No. PCR-2021-1260 (3-0 in
  favor; Lazzaro recused) with the following additional conditions: 1. Remove all rear yard hardscape
  from within the minimum required east side yard setback; 2. Eliminate the firepit and BBQ/grill from
  between the house and the pool; 3. BBQ/grill may be relocated to underneath the trellis; 4. Remove
  the deck off the upstairs master bedroom; 5. All windows on the upper floor’s east wall shall be
  translucent; 6. All windows on the west wall of the upper floor room labeled “Bathroom Three” shall
  be translucent; 7. The ridges shall reduce 2’ in elevation; 8. The property line wall along the east rear
  side yard shall be 6.5’ from grade; and 9. There shall be a hedge planted at a minimum of 8’ in height
  along the east side yard setback from the front gate to behind the spa where the property line turns at
  an angle.

7.  NC-1712-21, G-1658-21, & M-1492-21; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading, & Miscellaneous
  applications for a new single-family residence located at 844 Via Del Monte. Lot 10, Block 1540,
  Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title
  14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Tomaro Architecture, 2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
  Owner: Cherine Medawar

November 30, 2021 Planning Commission Actions  Page 2 of 4
December 21, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   Speakers: Wilma Schreck, Steven Goldsmith, Nitin Bhatia, Serena Lan, Leslie Lausch, Chad
  Brinderson

  Action: Walker moved to approve proposed Resolution No. PCR-2021-1249 with additional
  conditions that the home shall reduce 21’ in width and the decking shall reduce in area by 50%.
  No Commissioner seconded; Walker’s motion failed. Wade moved and Nendick seconded (3-0 in
  favor; Lazzaro recused) to continue the application to the December 21, 2021 Planning
  Commission meeting (starting at 5:30 pm; Zoom ID: 812 7872 5666).

NEW BUSINESS

  Verdes Estates Municipal Code and finding the action exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act

  Continued to the December 21, 2021 Planning Commission meeting starting at 5:30 pm
  (ZOOM ID: 812 7872 5666)

  single-family residence located at 2817 Via La Selva. Lot 5, Block 1804, Tract 7537. This project
  is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section

  Continued to the December 21, 2021 Planning Commission meeting starting at 5:30 pm
